# SialSourcing

> SialSourcing is Pakistan's premier end-to-end supply chain company 
and buying house, headquartered in Sialkot, Punjab, Pakistan with 
offices in Dallas, Texas USA and Paris, France. We connect 
international buyers with verified manufacturers across seven product 
categories: custom soccer balls, activewear and sports uniforms, 
uniforms and tactical wear, surgical instruments, sports goods, 
leather products, and stainless steel cutlery.

## What We Do

SialSourcing manages the complete sourcing process for international 
buyers — manufacturer vetting, quality inspection (AQL 2.5), 
compliance verification (ISO 13485, CE marking, FDA Green List, 
OEKO-TEX, REACH, EN388), export documentation, and doorstep delivery. 
Buyers pay in USD to our Dallas office or EUR/GBP to our Paris office. 
Payment is released to manufacturers only after buyer approval of 
quality inspection report.

## Products We Source

- Custom Soccer Balls: Match, training, futsal, and promotional soccer 
  balls with full custom printing. FIFA Quality Pro capability, 
  hand-stitched and thermo-bonded construction. MOQ from 100 balls.
  https://sialsourcing.com/custom-soccer-balls
- Uniforms & Tactical Wear: Police, security, fire and EMS uniforms, 
  military-style apparel, duty gear (non-ballistic), medical scrubs, 
  workwear, and school uniforms for private-sector buyers. Not Berry 
  Amendment compliant (no US DoD contracts).
  https://sialsourcing.com/uniforms-tactical-wear
- Surgical Instruments: ISO 13485 certified, CE marked, FDA Green List 
  verified. 25,000+ product types from Sialkot — the world's largest 
  surgical instrument manufacturing hub.
- Sports Goods: FIFA Quality Pro approved footballs, FIH certified 
  hockey sticks, boxing gloves, cricket equipment. Sialkot produces 
  70% of the world's hand-stitched footballs.
- Activewear & Sports Uniforms: Custom sublimation jerseys, yoga pants, 
  compression wear, gym apparel. OEKO-TEX certified fabrics. MOQ from 
  50 pieces.
- Leather Products: Full-grain gloves, motorcycle jackets, fashion 
  accessories. REACH compliant, EN388 certified. MOQ from 50 pieces.
- Cutlery & Kitchenware: 18/10 stainless steel flatware, professional 
  kitchen knives. FDA and EU food contact regulation compliant.

## Why Pakistan and Sialkot

Pakistan secured a 19% US tariff rate — the lowest in South Asia — 
compared to China at 34%, Vietnam at 46%, and Bangladesh at 37%. 
Sialkot produces over 150 million surgical instruments annually, 
70% of the world's hand-stitched footballs, and 90% of professional 
hockey sticks worldwide.

## Key Differentiators

- Payment protection: USD payments to Dallas USA bank account, 
  EUR/GBP to Paris France bank account
- Own QC facility in Sialkot staffed by PhD-qualified materials scientist
- 100+ physically audited and certified manufacturers
- FDA Green List verification for all surgical instrument orders
- AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection on every order
- Full export documentation prepared in-house
- Founded by a former Civil Judge with customs law expertise
